releases.title: nightly-2026.09.12-f04f8ac: fix(sandbox): allow webkit-required paths in desktop landlock ruleset
releases.notes:
With landlock on, webkit_user_content_manager_new crashed with
WebKit's deliberate-crash sentinel (0xbbadbeef) because init opens
/dev/null and friends outside the allowlist. Bisected empirically with a
cgo probe: read access to /dev is the minimum that unblocks it.

Desktop mode now grants RW on /tmp, /dev/shm (webkit IPC buffers), and
/dev/dri (render nodes for accelerated output), plus RO on /dev, /proc,
/sys, /var, and /run for fontconfig caches and hardware info. Verified
end to end: the AppImage launches and serves the UI with landlock
enabled.

releases.title: nightly-2026.09.12-81b99bc: docs(agents): expand prose rules for newer model tells
releases.notes:
Add banned patterns for 2025-2026 model output: -ing participle tails,
copula avoidance, unnamed attribution, chatbot residue, rule-of-three
adjective stacks, marketing register, and formulaic endings. Ban en dash
stand-ins, smart quotes, and zero-width characters alongside emdashes.
Note in AGENTS.md that the vendored no-ai-slop files carry local
additions that re-vendoring would overwrite.
